name: Bosch UniversalAquatak 125 1500W 125-Bar High Pressure Washer
shortDescription: Compact 1500W 125-bar high pressure washer with all-metal 3-cylinder pump, innovative 3-in-1 Trio Nozzle, and quiet motor technology for fast industrial cleaning.
overview: The Bosch UniversalAquatak 125 delivers effortless, fast cleaning performance across vehicles, factory floors, outdoor equipment, and masonry facades. Engineered with a durable all-metal 3-cylinder pump driven by a 1500W motor, it produces a powerful 125 bar of cleaning pressure with a maximum flow rate of 360 litres per hour. Its standout innovation is the 3-in-1 Trio Nozzle: simply twist the nozzle collar to switch instantly between Fan Jet for broad surfaces, Rotary Jet for blasted stubborn grime, and Pencil Jet for precision spot cleaning, eliminating the need to stop and swap lances.
keyFeatures: 1500W electric motor delivering max 125 Bar (12.5 MPa) pressure
Durable all-metal 3-cylinder high-pressure pump for extended operational life
3-in-1 Trio Nozzle features Fan Jet, Rotary Jet, and Pencil Jet in one head
Includes 450ml high-pressure detergent foam nozzle for rapid soap application
Self-priming capability allows drawing water from static tanks, drums, or water butts
Large transport wheels and folding push handle for easy maneuverability on job sites
Auto-Stop system shuts off motor and pump when gun trigger is released to save energy
applications: Heavy equipment degreasing and construction plant washdown
Fleet vehicle, truck, van, and car exterior washing
Cleaning concrete courtyards, paver walkways, and warehouse bays
Moss and algae removal from masonry walls, roofs, and stonework
